comments.value: Yas! This needs to be a thing again. <3
This older screen was easier on my eyes, too.
all of us remember the good loading screen

I have to agree, the VRChat loading screen been neading an update for awhile now. Though we are getting pre loading of worlds now, witch is a wonderful feature on its own. It be nice to have something less in your face. Those late night loads can be pretty jaring.

I want this so bad.

(Also, I still want a toggle to disable music during loading screen).

The old loading screen has been brought back in [VRChat 2026.1.3](https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrchat-202613) (March 31, 2026) for active VRC+ subscribers.

(Duplicate feature request.)

details: I think I speak for many with this request that we would love to have the old space loading screen back with its original music. Even a remastered version thats more optimized would be interesting!
title: 2016/2017 Loading Space screen
